entities.summary: Tremont Waters is a Puerto Rican professional basketball player for the Gigantes de Carolina of Baloncesto Superior Nacional (BSN). He played college basketball for the LSU Tigers, and was drafted in the second round of the 2019 NBA draft by the Boston Celtics.
